title: Integration Tests + Benchmarks + Skills + Hooks
description: End-to-end integration testing across all 43 failure modes. Benchmark feasibility analysis performance. Create slash commands for interactive use. Build hooks for auto-triggering feasibility checks.

units.title: End-to-end tests: 43 failure modes × multiple part geometries
steps: Test each of 7 geometry/access failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 9 workholding failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 7 rigidity failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 5 force/power failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 7 sequence/logic failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 5 simulation failure modes with specific test cases
Test each of 3 stock/material failure modes with specific test cases
Cross-system integration: PP pipeline → feasibility → simulation → output
exit_conditions: All 43 failure modes covered with at least 1 test each
No false negatives (every real dead-end detected)

units.title: Skills: /feasibility-check, /sequence-validate, /what-if + Hooks
steps: Create /feasibility-check skill: interactive full analysis via MCP chat
Create /sequence-validate skill: validate operation order with dead-end detection
Create /what-if skill: explore alternate operation sequences
Hookify: autofire-feasibility — run quick check before /program-gen output
Hookify: warn-sequence-risk — warn when operation sequence has >20% failure risk
